context: Reference focused cleanup: stream refactors must preserve regex-based line splitting semantics.

checklist.name: Creates coherent Java 17 artifact
checklist.description: Returns complete Java 17-compatible SourceDeclarations code with imports, records, methods, and Pattern usage intact.

checklist.name: Preserves regex line-break contract
checklist.description: Does not replace split("\\R", -1) with String.lines() unless it explicitly preserves the original regex line-break semantics; uses Pattern.splitAsStream or an equivalent regex-preserving source.

checklist.name: Produces declarations through stream result
checklist.description: Refactors the top-level extraction so streams produce the returned declarations directly rather than using forEach to mutate an external list.

checklist.name: Preserves inputs searched
checklist.description: Still searches title, description, and every comment text, and still ignores null or blank text blocks.

checklist.name: Preserves matching rule
checklist.description: Keeps LABELED_SOURCE.matcher(line).matches() semantics and Declaration construction from the captured source value.

checklist.name: Avoids side-effecting stream terminal
checklist.description: Does not keep text stream processing as text.lines().forEach(...) or another stream terminal that mutates a caller-owned list.

checklist.name: Keeps refactor focused
checklist.description: Does not add broad parser features, change source labels, change public records, or introduce unrelated abstractions.

metadata.reference_selection: Focused issue #47 coverage for regex line-splitting preservation during stream refactors.
metadata.runtime_reference_overlap_rationale: Allowed only as reference-suite focused coverage; do not report as ordinary broad lift if runtime references later teach this same shape.
